# Bing.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/bing-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/bing-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Bing.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Bing Search with Python](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-bing-search-using-python)
- **Code:** [`bing.py`](bing.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [SERP data](results/serps.json) · [Keyword data](results/keywords.json)

## What it scrapes

- Bing search pages for search results data
- Bing search pages for keyword data

## Functions

- `scrape_search(query, max_pages=None)`: scrape bing search pages
- `scrape_keywords(query)`: scrape bing search pages for keyword data

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import bing


async def main():
    search = await bing.scrape_search(query="web scraping emails", max_pages=3)
    keywords = await bing.scrape_keywords(query="web scraping emails")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/serps.json`](results/serps.json): `position`, `title`, `url`, `origin`, `domain`, `description`, `date`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`bing.py`](bing.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"GB"`: country of the proxy
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)
- `debug` = `True`: keep a screenshot and the full log in the Scrapfly dashboard
- `auto_scroll` = `True`: scroll the page to load lazy content

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/bing-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_serp_scraping`, `test_keyword_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
